svg.aria-label: Wiring diagram: devkit in the centre, modules left and right, power rails down both sides
svg.text: Shield USB-A → devkit USB-C: alternative supply for the devkit only
pins in logical order, not header order
100+10+1 µF on VCC are on the board: no external cap
R3 6.8k on TX → ~3 V at GPIO18
LED1 blinks: 0.8 s searching · 3 s registered
dashed = optional or not fitted yet · ⏚ = any GND pin on the shield · dots = junctions
